newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING -- Beijing Yanhua Petrochemical Co Ltd.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING -- Beijing Yanhua Petrochemical Co Ltd.

text.p: Beijing Yanhua Petrochemical Co Lt filed on Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering for up to 9,108,000 American Depositary Shares.

The ADS offering is part of a world-wide offering of an aggregate 1,012,000,000 H shares consisting of 9,108,000 ADS in the U.S. and Canada, 101,200,000 H shares and 9,108,000 ADSs outside the U.S., Canada and China.
The 9,108,000 ADS represent 455,400,000 H shares also known as overseas listed foreign invested shares.
The estimated price for the initial ADS offering is between US$10.99 and US$14.65.
Net proceeds will be used to repay certain debt and for expansion and construction projects for the company's production facilities, it said in the filing.

The joint global offering will be made through Bear, Stearns & Co Inc and SBC Warburg. The company has granted the U.S. underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 151,800,000 additional H shares.
The company has applied to the New York Stock Exchange to trade the ADS under the stock symbol BYH.N. The company is the largest producer of resins and plastics in China.
